title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1015 | 超级大南瓜、恐龙蘑菇、火星车纪录
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🎃 美国大叔种出 3156 磅巨型南瓜，打破世界纪录，成为史上第一个超过三千磅的南瓜！
🍄 中国云南发现新种巨型真菌“恐龙蘑菇”D-rex，比学校尺子还高，重得像只小猫！
🚀 NASA 火星车 Perseverance 无人驾驶 45.2 公里，创下人类在异星的最长驾驶纪录！

📖 Word of the day: gigantic（巨大的）

🎮 二选一：骑在汽车一样大的南瓜上滚下山坡，还是开着机器人小车横穿火星？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🎃 A 3,156-pound pumpkin in Rhode Island smashed the world record — the first pumpkin ever over 3,000 pounds!
🍄 Scientists found a new giant fungus nicknamed D-rex in Yunnan, China — taller than a school ruler, as heavy as a small cat!
🚀 NASA's Perseverance rover drove itself 45.2 kilometers across Mars — the longest drive ever on another world!

📖 Word of the day: gigantic

🎮 Would you rather: ride a car-sized pumpkin rolling downhill, or drive a robot car across Mars? Ask your mom and dad too!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. gigantic（巨大的）
really, really, REALLY big
例：a gigantic pumpkin（巨大的南瓜）

2. weigh（重达）
to be how heavy something is
例：it weighs three thousand pounds（它重达三千磅）

3. fungus（真菌）
a living thing like a mushroom, but not a plant
例：a giant fungus（巨型真菌）

4. rover（火星车）
a small robot car that explores new places
例：the Mars rover（火星车）
